header: WORDS IN AN ANNOUNCEMENT THAT OPEN ITS PDF (pure). A word or a group of words of the body can be made a link to the announcement's PDF: the author selects them and presses "PDF link" in the editor's toolbar. The link carries NO address: it is the marker data-pdf-link on an <a> element, nothing else. The announcement's window (src/components/AnnouncementModal.tsx) turns a click on it into "open the PDF full screen"; the PDF is the one the announcement has (src/lib/announcements/attachment.ts, served by our own route). Because I give the link no address, nothing can be made to point anywhere else, whatever is pasted or typed. An announcement with NO PDF cannot have such a link: the saving code (admin/store.ts) turns the words back into plain text, and so does the window when it knows there is no PDF.

behaviours: a body is found to have a PDF link, or not
taking the links off keeps the words, in place, and every link of the body goes
taking them off when there are none changes nothing (and nothing breaks on empty input)
words with other marks inside the link survive: bold, red
an ordinary link with an address is not a PDF link and is left for the saving code to flatten
the editor's mark writes an <a> with the marker and no address, reads it back from a saved body, and does not extend when typing at its end

the editor switches StarterKit's own Link off (it keeps an address and links typed web addresses), adds the PDF link mark, and has the toolbar button, switched off unless a PDF is available, which toggles the mark on selected words and off inside linked words
the panel allows the button only when the announcement has a PDF (one chosen now, or its own not being removed), shows how to use it, and warns when linked words have no PDF to open
the store keeps links only where there is a PDF: a publish without a file, and an edit that ends with none, save plain words
